info.name: Secure Office
info.summary: Nextcloud Secure Office - Forensic Watermarking and DLP for Collabora
info.description: Nextcloud Secure Office provides enterprise-grade document security, dynamic forensic watermarking, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls for Nextcloud Office (Collabora Online), aligned with the Spanish National Security Framework (ENS - RD 311/2022).
info.author: Norberto Martín Afonso
